goal: Implement flagzen-key-mapping and flagzen-env modules providing environment-variable-based flag resolution with reusable key-mapping infrastructure

phases.name: Walking Skeleton
phases.description: Thinnest E2E slice: Gradle module setup for flagzen-key-mapping and flagzen-env, default screaming-snake-case parser, default kebab-case formatter, eager loading into immutable map, FlagProvider contract. Proves the entire pipeline end-to-end.

steps.name: Zero-config flag resolution from environment variable
steps.description: Set up both Gradle submodules (flagzen-key-mapping, flagzen-env), wire acceptance test infrastructure, implement the thinnest slice: FLAGZEN_ prefix screaming-snake-case parser, kebab-case formatter, eager loading pipeline, and FlagProvider.getString(). One env var in, one flag value out.
criteria: settings.gradle.kts includes flagzen-key-mapping and flagzen-env
flagzen-key-mapping/build.gradle.kts exists with java-library plugin and zero production dependencies
flagzen-env/build.gradle.kts exists with api dependency on flagzen-key-mapping and implementation dependency on flagzen-core
flagzen-acceptance-tests/build.gradle.kts includes flagzen-env as testImplementation dependency and adds flagzen-env feature path to cucumber.features
FlagKeyParser SAM interface exists in com.flagzen.keymapping
FlagKeyParsers.screamingSnakeCase(String prefix) factory method exists
FlagKeyFormat SAM interface exists in com.flagzen.keymapping
FlagKeyFormats.kebabCase() factory method exists
EnvironmentVariableFlagProvider.create() constructs a provider with default parser and formatter
Provider eagerly loads env vars at construction into immutable map
getString(key) returns Optional with the value for a matching FLAGZEN_ prefixed env var
Scenario 'Developer resolves a flag from an environment variable with zero configuration' passes
steps.scenario_name: Developer resolves a flag from an environment variable with zero configuration

steps.name: Missing flag key returns no value
steps.description: Verify that looking up a flag key with no matching environment variable returns Optional.empty(). Proves the negative path of the immutable map lookup.
criteria: getString(key) returns Optional.empty() when no env var maps to the given flag key
Scenario 'Missing flag key returns no value' passes
steps.scenario_name: Missing flag key returns no value

phases.name: Key Mapping
phases.description: Complete the flagzen-key-mapping module: all built-in parsers (screaming snake case, camel case, snake case with/without prefix), all built-in formatters (kebab, snake, camel, pascal, dot, colon), single-segment handling, and custom lambda support.

steps.name: Screaming snake case parser with prefix extracts segments
steps.description: Verify that the screaming-snake-case parser with a given prefix strips the prefix and splits on underscores into lowercase segments.
criteria: screamingSnakeCase('FLAGZEN_') parser parses 'FLAGZEN_CHECKOUT_FLOW' into segments ['checkout', 'flow']
Scenario 'Screaming snake case parser with prefix extracts segments' passes
steps.scenario_name: Screaming snake case parser with prefix extracts segments

steps.name: Screaming snake case parser rejects names without matching prefix
steps.description: Verify that the screaming-snake-case parser returns Optional.empty() when the input does not start with the configured prefix.
criteria: screamingSnakeCase('FLAGZEN_') parser returns Optional.empty() for 'HOME'
Scenario 'Screaming snake case parser rejects names without matching prefix' passes
steps.scenario_name: Screaming snake case parser rejects names without matching prefix

steps.name: Screaming snake case parser without prefix parses any screaming snake name
steps.description: Verify that the no-prefix variant of the screaming-snake-case parser matches any ALL_CAPS_UNDERSCORE name.
criteria: screamingSnakeCase() parser parses 'CHECKOUT_FLOW' into segments ['checkout', 'flow']
Scenario 'Screaming snake case parser without prefix parses any screaming snake name' passes
steps.scenario_name: Screaming snake case parser without prefix parses any screaming snake name

steps.name: Screaming snake case parser handles single-segment name
steps.description: Verify that a single-segment name (no underscore after prefix) produces a list with one segment.
criteria: screamingSnakeCase('FLAGZEN_') parser parses 'FLAGZEN_DARKMODE' into single segment ['darkmode']
Scenario 'Screaming snake case parser handles single-segment name' passes
steps.scenario_name: Screaming snake case parser handles single-segment name

steps.name: Camel case parser with prefix extracts segments
steps.description: Implement camelCase(String prefix) parser that strips the prefix and splits on uppercase boundaries into lowercase segments.
criteria: camelCase('myApp') parser parses 'myAppCheckoutFlow' into segments ['checkout', 'flow']
Scenario 'Camel case parser with prefix extracts segments' passes
steps.scenario_name: Camel case parser with prefix extracts segments

steps.name: Camel case parser rejects names without matching prefix
steps.description: Verify that camelCase parser returns Optional.empty() when the input does not start with the configured prefix.
criteria: camelCase('myApp') parser returns Optional.empty() for 'FLAGZEN_CHECKOUT_FLOW'
Scenario 'Camel case parser rejects names without matching prefix' passes
steps.scenario_name: Camel case parser rejects names without matching prefix

steps.name: Camel case parser without prefix parses bare camel case name
steps.description: Implement camelCase() no-prefix variant that splits any camelCase name on uppercase boundaries.
criteria: camelCase() parser parses 'checkoutFlow' into segments ['checkout', 'flow']
Scenario 'Camel case parser without prefix parses bare camel case name' passes
steps.scenario_name: Camel case parser without prefix parses bare camel case name

steps.name: Built-in formatters produce correct flag keys
steps.description: Implement all six built-in formatters (kebab, snake, camel, pascal, dot, colon) and verify each produces the correct flag key from segments. This is one Scenario Outline covering 6 examples.
criteria: kebabCase() formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'checkout-flow'
snakeCase() formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'checkout_flow'
camelCase() formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'checkoutFlow'
pascalCase() formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'CheckoutFlow'
dotCase() formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'checkout.flow'
colonCase() formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'checkout:flow'
Scenario Outline 'Built-in formatter produces correct flag key' passes for all 6 examples
steps.scenario_name: Built-in formatter produces correct flag key

steps.name: Formatter handles single segment without delimiter
steps.description: Verify that formatting a single segment produces the segment itself with no delimiter appended.
criteria: kebabCase() formats ['darkmode'] to 'darkmode'
Scenario 'Formatter handles single segment without delimiter' passes
steps.scenario_name: Formatter handles single segment without delimiter

steps.name: Custom lambda formatter applies custom delimiter
steps.description: Verify that a custom FlagKeyFormat lambda can be provided to join segments with an arbitrary delimiter.
criteria: A custom formatter joining with '/' formats ['checkout', 'flow'] to 'checkout/flow'
Scenario 'Custom lambda formatter applies custom delimiter' passes
steps.scenario_name: Custom lambda formatter applies custom delimiter

phases.name: Env Provider
phases.description: Complete the flagzen-env module: default configuration scenarios, eager loading and immutable map guarantees, ServiceLoader discovery, builder API with custom parsers and formatters, and error paths for unparseable typed values.

steps.name: Default configuration resolves multi-segment flag key
steps.description: Verify that default-configured provider correctly resolves a multi-segment FLAGZEN_ env var to a kebab-case flag key.
criteria: FLAGZEN_MAX_RETRY_COUNT=5 resolves to flag 'max-retry-count' with value '5'
Scenario 'Default configuration resolves multi-segment flag key' passes
steps.scenario_name: Default configuration resolves multi-segment flag key

steps.name: Default configuration resolves single-segment flag key
steps.description: Verify that a single-segment FLAGZEN_ env var resolves correctly without delimiters.
criteria: FLAGZEN_DARKMODE=on resolves to flag 'darkmode' with value 'on'
Scenario 'Default configuration resolves single-segment flag key' passes
steps.scenario_name: Default configuration resolves single-segment flag key

steps.name: Non-matching environment variables are excluded from flag map
steps.description: Verify that env vars without the FLAGZEN_ prefix are excluded and do not appear in flag lookups.
criteria: HOME=/Users/kenji is excluded from the flag map
FLAGZEN_DARK_MODE=true maps to flag 'dark-mode'
Looking up 'home' returns no value
Scenario 'Non-matching environment variables are excluded from flag map' passes
steps.scenario_name: Non-matching environment variables are excluded from flag map

steps.name: Flag lookups are consistent after construction
steps.description: Verify that repeated lookups of the same key always return the same value, proving immutability.
criteria: Multiple getString() calls for the same key return identical values
Scenario 'Flag lookups are consistent after construction' passes
steps.scenario_name: Flag lookups are consistent after construction

steps.name: Empty environment variable value is preserved
steps.description: Verify that an env var set to an empty string is preserved as an empty string (not treated as missing).
criteria: FLAGZEN_CHECKOUT_FLOW='' resolves to flag 'checkout-flow' with value ''
getString() returns Optional.of('') not Optional.empty()
Scenario 'Empty environment variable value is preserved' passes
steps.scenario_name: Empty environment variable value is preserved

steps.name: Context-aware lookup ignores evaluation context for static env vars
steps.description: Verify that getString(key, context) delegates to getString(key), ignoring the evaluation context since env vars are static.
criteria: getString(key, context) returns same value as getString(key)
Scenario 'Context-aware lookup ignores evaluation context for static env vars' passes
steps.scenario_name: Context-aware lookup ignores evaluation context for static env vars

steps.name: Provider is discoverable via service loading
steps.description: Register EnvironmentVariableFlagProvider in META-INF/services and verify ServiceLoader discovers it.
criteria: META-INF/services/com.flagzen.spi.FlagProvider contains com.flagzen.env.EnvironmentVariableFlagProvider
ServiceLoader.load(FlagProvider.class) includes EnvironmentVariableFlagProvider
Scenario 'Provider is discoverable via service loading' passes
steps.scenario_name: Provider is discoverable via service loading

steps.name: Auto-discovered provider resolves flags with default configuration
steps.description: Verify that the ServiceLoader-discovered instance resolves flags using default configuration.
criteria: Auto-discovered provider resolves FLAGZEN_CHECKOUT_FLOW=STREAMLINED to flag 'checkout-flow'
Scenario 'Auto-discovered provider resolves flags with default configuration' passes
steps.scenario_name: Auto-discovered provider resolves flags with default configuration

steps.name: Builder accepts a custom prefix parser
steps.description: Implement the builder API and verify that a custom prefix parser (e.g., FF_) replaces the default FLAGZEN_ parser.
criteria: builder().parser(screamingSnakeCase('FF_')).build() resolves FF_ prefixed env vars
Scenario 'Builder accepts a custom prefix parser' passes
steps.scenario_name: Builder accepts a custom prefix parser

steps.name: Custom prefix parser excludes non-matching environment variables
steps.description: Verify that when using a custom prefix parser, env vars with the old default prefix are excluded.
criteria: Provider with FF_ parser does not resolve FLAGZEN_ prefixed env vars
Scenario 'Custom prefix parser excludes non-matching environment variables' passes
steps.scenario_name: Custom prefix parser excludes non-matching environment variables

steps.name: Builder accepts a custom lambda parser
steps.description: Verify that a custom FlagKeyParser lambda can be provided to the builder for arbitrary parsing logic.
criteria: Custom lambda parser for 'FEAT_' prefix works through the builder
Scenario 'Builder accepts a custom lambda parser' passes
steps.scenario_name: Builder accepts a custom lambda parser

steps.name: Builder accepts a custom formatter
steps.description: Verify that a custom formatter (e.g., snake case) can replace the default kebab-case formatter via the builder.
criteria: builder().formatter(snakeCase()).build() formats flag keys with underscores
Scenario 'Builder accepts a custom formatter' passes
steps.scenario_name: Builder accepts a custom formatter

steps.name: Unparseable integer value returns no typed result but string is available
steps.description: Verify that getInt() returns empty for non-numeric strings while getString() still returns the raw value.
criteria: getInt('max-retries') returns Optional.empty() when value is 'not-a-number'
getString('max-retries') returns 'not-a-number'
Scenario 'Unparseable integer value returns no typed result but string is available' passes
steps.scenario_name: Unparseable integer value returns no typed result but string is available

steps.name: Unparseable boolean value returns no typed result but string is available
steps.description: Verify that getBoolean() returns empty for non-boolean strings while getString() still returns the raw value.
criteria: getBoolean('dark-mode') returns Optional.empty() when value is 'maybe'
getString('dark-mode') returns 'maybe'
Scenario 'Unparseable boolean value returns no typed result but string is available' passes
steps.scenario_name: Unparseable boolean value returns no typed result but string is available

phases.name: Conflict Strategy
phases.description: Complete conflict handling: multiple parsers contributing flags, multiple formatters producing multiple keys, cardinality-based default strategy selection, WARN and ERROR behavior at construction time, and first-access warnings for conflicted keys.

steps.name: Multiple parsers contribute different flags from different conventions
steps.description: Verify that configuring multiple parsers allows resolving flags from different naming conventions simultaneously.
criteria: FLAGZEN_ and myApp parsers together resolve flags from both conventions
Scenario 'Multiple parsers contribute different flags from different conventions' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple parsers contribute different flags from different conventions

steps.name: Multiple parsers with no overlapping flags produce no conflict
steps.description: Verify that when multiple parsers each match different env vars with no flag key overlap, no conflict is raised.
criteria: Two parsers matching non-overlapping env vars produce no conflict warning
Scenario 'Multiple parsers with no overlapping flags produce no conflict' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple parsers with no overlapping flags produce no conflict

steps.name: Multiple formatters produce multiple flag keys from one environment variable
steps.description: Verify that configuring multiple formatters produces multiple flag key entries from a single env var.
criteria: kebab and snake formatters together produce both 'checkout-flow' and 'checkout_flow' from FLAGZEN_CHECKOUT_FLOW
Scenario 'Multiple formatters produce multiple flag keys from one environment variable' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple formatters produce multiple flag keys from one environment variable

steps.name: Single-segment key resolves identically from both formatters
steps.description: Verify that a single-segment name (no delimiter) resolves to the same key from both formatters without conflict.
criteria: FLAGZEN_DARKMODE with kebab+snake formatters both produce 'darkmode' -- same value, no real conflict
Scenario 'Single-segment key resolves identically from both formatters' passes
steps.scenario_name: Single-segment key resolves identically from both formatters

steps.name: Single parser and single formatter default to warn on conflict
steps.description: Implement cardinality-based default strategy selection. 1 parser + 1 formatter defaults to WARN.
criteria: Builder with 1 parser and 1 formatter and no explicit strategy defaults to WARN
Scenario 'Single parser and single formatter default to warn on conflict' passes
steps.scenario_name: Single parser and single formatter default to warn on conflict

steps.name: Multiple parsers and single formatter default to warn on conflict
steps.description: Verify that N parsers + 1 formatter defaults to WARN.
criteria: Builder with 2 parsers and 1 formatter and no explicit strategy defaults to WARN
Scenario 'Multiple parsers and single formatter default to warn on conflict' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple parsers and single formatter default to warn on conflict

steps.name: Single parser and multiple formatters default to warn on conflict
steps.description: Verify that 1 parser + N formatters defaults to WARN.
criteria: Builder with 1 parser and 2 formatters and no explicit strategy defaults to WARN
Scenario 'Single parser and multiple formatters default to warn on conflict' passes
steps.scenario_name: Single parser and multiple formatters default to warn on conflict

steps.name: Multiple parsers and multiple formatters default to error on conflict
steps.description: Verify that N parsers + N formatters (cartesian explosion risk) defaults to ERROR.
criteria: Builder with 2 parsers and 2 formatters and no explicit strategy defaults to ERROR
Scenario 'Multiple parsers and multiple formatters default to error on conflict' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple parsers and multiple formatters default to error on conflict

steps.name: Multiple parsers and multiple formatters can be overridden to warn
steps.description: Verify that the N x N default of ERROR can be explicitly overridden to WARN via onConflict().
criteria: builder().onConflict(WARN) overrides the N x N default of ERROR
Scenario 'Multiple parsers and multiple formatters can be overridden to warn' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple parsers and multiple formatters can be overridden to warn

steps.name: Warn strategy logs conflict and continues operating
steps.description: Verify that WARN strategy logs a conflict warning with both env var names and continues operating normally.
criteria: WARN strategy produces a log warning mentioning both conflicting env var names
Provider continues operating after conflict
Scenario 'Warn strategy logs conflict and continues operating' passes
steps.scenario_name: Warn strategy logs conflict and continues operating

steps.name: Error strategy rejects construction when conflict is detected
steps.description: Verify that ERROR strategy throws IllegalStateException with both env var names and the flag key in the message.
criteria: ERROR strategy throws IllegalStateException at construction
Error message mentions both env var names and the conflicted flag key
Scenario 'Error strategy rejects construction when conflict is detected' passes
steps.scenario_name: Error strategy rejects construction when conflict is detected

steps.name: First access of a conflicted flag key produces a warning
steps.description: Implement first-access warning: on the first getString() call for a conflicted key, log a warning.
criteria: First getString() call on a conflicted key produces a warning log
Scenario 'First access of a conflicted flag key produces a warning' passes
steps.scenario_name: First access of a conflicted flag key produces a warning

steps.name: Subsequent access of the same conflicted flag key produces no warning
steps.description: Verify that the second and subsequent getString() calls for the same conflicted key produce no additional warning.
criteria: Second getString() call on the same conflicted key produces no warning
Scenario 'Subsequent access of the same conflicted flag key produces no warning' passes
steps.scenario_name: Subsequent access of the same conflicted flag key produces no warning

steps.name: Non-conflicted flag key produces no warning on access
steps.description: Verify that getString() for a non-conflicted key produces no warning at any time.
criteria: getString() for a non-conflicted key never produces a warning
Scenario 'Non-conflicted flag key produces no warning on access' passes
steps.scenario_name: Non-conflicted flag key produces no warning on access
